description: Liste der Batteriespeicher (Großbatterien) in Deutschland. Teilmenge des Datensatzes de-kraftwerke (Brennstofftyp „Battery“). All 1,167 power generation and storage units in Germany from the powerplantmatching (PyPSA) merged European power plant dataset: name, fuel type, technology, capacity (MW), efficiency, commissioning/retrofit/retirement year, coordinates, storage attributes (duration, reservoir volume, dam height, storage capacity), ENTSO-E EIC codes and cross-referenced upstream source IDs (MaStR, ENTSO-E, JRC, GEM, GPD, OPSD, GEO and others).
